mentions.name: GetSetReply
mentions.description: This platform provides text message (SMS) marketing tools for small and medium businesses, enabling campaigns through what the author calls the strongest but most heavily regulated marketing channel. A new site design is in progress that will replace the existing site.
mentions.problem: Text message marketing is one of the strongest but most regulated marketing channels to work with.
mentions.audience: Small and medium businesses (SMBs) looking to market via text message.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on marketing tools for SMBs. Text message marketing is quite possibly the strongest but most regulated channel for marketing.

Here is the new site design I'm working on: https://getsetreply2.com/

Here is the existing site which will be updated to the above one: https://getsetreply.com/
